scope: Device dialog action wording, compact action widths, and consistent outlined button foreground color in dialog bodies.
decision: ADR 0094 retains response scope and equal acknowledgment/pause widths; maintainer requested shorter labels and matching button appearance.
task_owner: Shared device issue dialog owns issue response. Policies, Notifications and Open device retain their existing destinations.
user_benefit: Acknowledge, Pause and Stop Monitoring are easier to scan; outlined buttons use the same theme accent as Open device.
disclosure: No new disclosure or navigation. Existing Pause duration and Stop Monitoring confirmation retain their separate scopes.

checks.visual_review: pass; desktop and narrow dialog captures inspected for label clarity, color consistency and reachable controls; narrow content scrolls.

paths.controls: All issues, individual selection, acknowledge, pause, cancellation and current-issue updates
paths.expected: Exact selected current IDs receive independent results; zero selection disables actions, ended/new IDs never inherit a pending request, partial failures remain explicit, and one remaining issue uses direct actions.
evidence: issues/1440px/light: device-issue-selection.html (1440px, light): Synthetic backend; existing fixture uses DOM-scripted interactions. This is not real Home Assistant acceptance. Unrelated issues stay unchanged; all requests are mocks.

paths.controls: Device View, partial availability and missing evidence, other conditions, unattached entity, exact issue links and return
paths.expected: One shared device dialog includes current problems owned by that registry device with all initially selected. Unattached and wider issues retain exact scope; notification links retain their original issue. Close and browser Back restore the originating view; compact controls fit phone and enlarged text.
evidence: issues/1440px/light: device-issue-selection.html (1440px, light): Synthetic backend; existing fixture uses DOM-scripted interactions. This is not real Home Assistant acceptance. The Open issues device heading opens the same device context for entity-only and battery problems. All current device issues initially select, one battery exception can be acknowledged independently, and close returns to the queue. An unattached entity retains its exact singular dialog. Device actions use Acknowledge, Pause and Stop Monitoring, match the outlined Open device colors, and retain touch targets. Device details omit ambiguous opening chronology.

paths.controls: One View, native entity/device links, policy return and separate Stop Monitoring review
paths.expected: The combined dialog retains current device context and exact return; native links remain distinct, coverage cancellation saves nothing, and issue selection does not redefine monitoring exclusions.
evidence: issues/1440px/light: device-issue-selection.html (1440px, light): Synthetic backend; existing fixture uses DOM-scripted interactions. This is not real Home Assistant acceptance. Monitoring offers one combined View and native entity links. Shared dialog has one Open device, policy return preserves device context, and Stop Monitoring reviews its independent coverage without saving on cancellation.
